roles.name: Lead
roles.description: Triages development health across the full capability chain (P1-P5), escalates critical issues, and orchestrates optimization cycles for highest-leverage improvements.

roles.name: Skill Specialist
roles.description: Resolves cross-skill conflicts, audits and improves the skill library, and increases skill maturity.

roles.name: Agent Specialist
roles.description: Audits and improves agent configurations for clarity, effectiveness, and appropriate skill references.

roles.name: Team Specialist
roles.description: Audits and improves team structures, role definitions, and cross-team coordination.
